layer_change_gcode:
;AFTER_LAYER_CHANGE
;[layer_z]
{if layer_num > 0}
; purge, cool, then wipe on the printer's own chute
G1 Z{layer_z + 0.4} F600
box_save_fan
box_go_to_extrude_pos
M83
G1 E{retraction_length[0] + 6} F180
G1 E-{retraction_length[0]} F2400
M106 S255
G4 P5000
box_nozzle_clean
box_restore_fan
box_move_to_safe_pos
M83
G1 Z{layer_z} F600
{endif}
name: Creality K2 Plus 0.4 nozzle - Purge and Wipe Nozzle After Each Layer
printer_settings_id: Creality K2 Plus 0.4 nozzle - Purge and Wipe Nozzle After Each Layer
